shortDescription: UPSSSC Forest Guard / Wild Life Guard Main Exam Fee Payment 2026 for 708 posts under Advt. No. 12-Exam/2026. Mains examination is scheduled for 27 September 2026.
content:
Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has issued the Main Examination fee payment update for Forest Guard / Wild Life Guard posts under Advt. No. 12-Exam/2026.

The recruitment covers 708 posts. Eligible PET candidates should pay the Rs. 25 main examination fee through the official UPSSSC portal and keep the payment receipt safe.

Important information

  • Application window: 30 June 2026 to 20 July 2026
  • Eligibility result available: 27 August 2026
  • Main examination date: 27 September 2026
  • Admit card: before the examination

Use the official UPSSSC links below for fee payment, eligibility result, notice and admit card updates.
